reviews.review: боевка дерьмо, консольная кишка, гринд в сетевухе, таланты не понятно то работаеют то нет, за сюжетку баксов 15 ок, но 40 много, 3/10

TLDR: To beat higher difficulties you need better guns which you can only unlock through beating higher difficulty missions, or upgrading armory data (grinding). (Operations mode review, campaign was fine)

I want to recommend this game but I really can't. Its more about watching the screen for blue and red flashing symbols to know when to block or when to dodge, but also trying to block smaller enemies who quickly chip away at your armor blocks and timing that to block smaller enemies to get armor blocks back. Mistime a couple blocks and you lose health which is hard to get back unless you have high level perks on your character or guns.

You can't get to the later perks for your guns unless you have armory data of certain rarities. The issue from that is average to substantial difficulty seems to be a massive jump. Granted I am playing with bots as I don't have time to play with other people or need to pause often but I don't consider myself a bad enough gamer to not be able to do the "middle" difficulty.

You can get lucky on some missions and the wave spawning not be too bad or you get completely flooded and are trying to time blocks while having 6 or more majoris enemies around you, with one small mistime on a block meaning your health is chipped away for future battles, if you even make it that far. I would completely expect that from higher difficulties, but not when you are trying to go up just one step in difficulty meaning most the time you will fail the mission.

I can't recommend this game. It is very grindy, and although the gameplay is satisfying at times it can also be very irritating. If the bots improve or can use your perks etc then it would be a yes from me, otherwise I just don't have the time to play full sessions without being able to pause due to family.
